mapper.select: SELECT CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_point_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effective_from<=#{at} ORDER BY effective_from DESC,version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(policy_json AS CHAR) policy_json FROM member_point_policy WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND version>#{after} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_point_account(tenant_id,member_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id=member_id
mapper.select: SELECT debt,version FROM member_point_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_point_account SET debt=#{debt},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND version=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id,GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(IF(l.expires_at>#{at},l.remaining,0)),0)-COALESCE(a.debt,0),0) available, COALESCE(SUM(l.held),0) held,COALESCE(a.debt,0) debt,COALESCE(SUM(IF(l.expires_at>#{at},l.remaining,0)),0) credit,COALESCE(a.version,0) version FROM member_record m LEFT JOIN member_point_account a ON a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND a.member_id=m.member_id LEFT JOIN member_point_lot l ON l.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND l.member_id=m.member_id AND l.active_balance=TRUE WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND m.member_id=#{member} GROUP BY m.member_id,a.debt,a.version
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(IF(expires_at>#{at},remaining,0)),0) credit,COALESCE(SUM(held),0) held FROM member_point_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND active_balance=TRUE FOR UPDATE

SELECT member_id,CAST(paid AS CHAR) paid,completed,policy_version,CAST(earn_rate AS CHAR) earn_rate,expiry_days,contribution FROM member_point_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_point_order SET completed=#{completed},contribution=#{contribution} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id,CAST(amount AS CHAR) amount FROM member_point_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND refund_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) AS CHAR) FROM member_point_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM member_point_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lot_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE member_point_lot SET remaining=#{remaining},held=#{held},expired=#{expired} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND lot_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_point_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND active_balance=TRUE AND remaining>0 AND expires_at>#{at} ORDER BY expires_at,lot_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM member_point_lot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND active_balance=TRUE AND remaining>0 AND expires_at<=#{at} ORDER BY expires_at,lot_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id,member_id,lot_id FROM member_point_lot WHERE active_balance=TRUE AND remaining>0 AND expires_at<=#{at} ORDER BY expires_at,tenant_id,lot_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT sequence_id,action,source_id,delta,available,debt,policy_version,reason,created_at,held FROM member_point_ledger WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND sequence_id>#{after} ORDER BY sequence_id LIMIT #{limit}
